OpCodes.js

The file is a test fixture: the JavaScript importer is held to it, and node runs it as the oracle
for the functions that import. It is kept byte for byte as the commit has it - do not reformat it,
and replace it only as a whole with the file of a newer commit, updating commit and hash here.

OpCodes.import.txt beside it is not part of Cipher. It records which functions of this file the
importer accepts and which diagnostic refuses each of the others; the tests regenerate and compare
it (POLYPILER_RECORD=1 writes it anew).

The other *.mjs files in this directory were written for this repository. The files in recorded/
hold what node did when it ran them, one call per line; the acceptance tests run node again and
compare (POLYPILER_RECORD=1 writes them anew).
